rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a drug or substance that raises physiological or nervous activity.

example.english: This stimulant can make your heartbeat faster, so don't take it casually.
example.traditional: 呢種興奮劑會令心跳加快，唔可以亂食。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hing1 fan5 zai1 wui5 ling6 sam1 tiu3 gaa1 faai3 m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 sik6

rows.note: Use this for an everyday stimulant intended mainly to keep someone awake or alert, such as a caffeine product.

example.english: I had a stimulant to stay awake at work this morning.
example.traditional: 朝早返工眼瞓，我飲咗罐提神劑。
example.jyutping: ziu1 zou2 faan1 gung1 ngaan5 fan3 ngo5 jam2 zo2 gun3 tai4 san4 zai1

rows.note: Use this for an abstract thing that motivates someone or drives activity and enthusiasm.

example.english: For me, my family's support is the stimulant that keeps me going.
example.traditional: 對我嚟講，屋企人嘅支持就係我繼續捱落去嘅動力。
example.jyutping: deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 uk1 kei2 jan4 ge3 zi1 ci4 zau6 hai6 ngo5 gai3 zuk6 ngaai4 lok6 heoi3 ge3 dung6 lik6
